items.headline: Continental AG cuts tire manufacturing downtime 37% saving EUR 8M annually with predictive maintenance AI
items.summary: Continental AG deployed predictive maintenance across 4 tire manufacturing plants monitoring 12,000 sensors and processing 800 million data points daily. ML models analyze vibration, temperature, current, and acoustic data to predict equipment failures 48-72 hours before they occur, achieving 37% downtime reduction and EUR 8 million in annual savings.

items.headline: Accenture confirms breach after hacker steals 35GB of source code and cloud access keys
items.summary: Threat actor 888 breached Accenture in July 2026 stealing 35GB of source code, RSA keys, SSH keys, Azure Personal Access Tokens, Azure Storage access keys, and configuration files posted on PwnForums. Accenture called it an isolated matter with no impact to operations, but did not disclose attack vector or whether customer data was affected.
